title: Showcase invoice: the pre-tax roll-up reads "Total" / "合计" beside "Total incl. Tax" because the translation bundle labels the Subtotal field Total
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5okniknzVVR3KTSVr1

Filing gate: ① a user-visible misleading label with a named producer, found by the #36249 developer on PR #36293 (dev report on #36249, comment 7074836167, `out_of_scope_findings`). ⛔ Not a claim.

## 维护者速读
- 问题：showcase 发票的税前合计字段在元数据里叫「Subtotal」（小计），但英文和中文语言包把它译成「Total」/「合计」，于是记录页和编辑表单上「Total €230.00」紧挨着「Total incl. Tax €276.00」。
- 影响：读者分不清哪个是税前、哪个是含税。
- 这一步做什么：把语言包里的标签改回「小计」的意思。
- 要你做的：无。

## What happens

On a booted showcase, invoice INV-1010 (EUR) shows `Total €230.00` right beside `Total incl. Tax €276.00`, on both the record page and the edit form. The line-grid summary stack labels the same figure `Subtotal`, and the object metadata labels `showcase_invoice.total` `Subtotal`. The translation bundle in `examples/app-showcase/src/system/translations/index.ts` sets `showcase_invoice.fields.total.label` to `Total` (en) and `合计` (zh-CN).

## Asked

The showcase bundle labels `showcase_invoice.total` as a subtotal in every language it ships (en `Subtotal`, zh-CN `小计`, and the rest to match), so the pre-tax and tax-inclusive figures read differently.

## Done when

INV-1010's record page and edit form read `Subtotal €230.00` beside `Total incl. Tax €276.00` (and the zh-CN equivalent).

Reader: `domain:ui` / showcase fixture, `area:ux`. Related: #36249 (PR #36293), #36005 (PR #36233).

Dedupe: `showcase invoice total label Subtotal translation`, `invoice subtotal labelled Total`, `小计 合计 标签` (objectstack issues, open) → none found at filing.
